caption: Signed daylight errors grouped by target UTC hour, with rows for 30/120/300 minute leads and columns for systems. Line: mean prediction minus corrected target; band: empirical 25th–75th percentiles, not confidence intervals. All four future folds are pooled with equal weight per eligible target pair, not equal day/fold weighting. Positive errors mean overprediction. Hourly sample and day counts are in the source table; daylight availability and season composition vary by hour. Post-study descriptive analysis; no additional significance tests.
